The serum is GREAT if you're a beginner, but only somewhat decent if you're experienced. If you have sensitive skin or haven't tried the active ingredients in this serum, then it's a great serum to start with since it's gentle and has tons of ceramides to protect your skins natural barrier. That being said, for experienced active users, the vitamin c does virtually nothing in this product and I saw limited results after a solid month of daily use. The tranexamic acid, alpha arbutin, and niacinamide are the heavy hitters in this product. Although they only slightly reduce post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (or post acne dark marks), it does help to minimize how severe or dark new marks are from ongoing breakouts. And the ceramides are a great touch for both barrier replenishment and moisturizing. For the price though, I was really hoping this product would be as strong if not stronger than when I applied the Inkey lists tranexamic acid and alpha arbutin together without all the other ingredients in bubbles product. Those two actives from Inkey when combined worked wonders for my hyperpigmentation and in way less time, but bubbles product really fell short. However, I am going to give it one more months effort just to be sure. I don't hate the product, I just want a much stronger version of it. Please make a stronger version!
